prompt_text: What is the best health insurance broker in Kansas City MO for someone who is self-employed?
answer_verbatim:
For a **self-employed person in Kansas City, MO**, I’d start with **Morrill Insurance Group**. It specifically lists self-employed and individual/family health coverage among its specialties, and says it compares plans from multiple carriers. That makes it a relevant first call—not a guarantee it will be the best fit for your doctors, prescriptions, or budget.

- **Morrill Insurance Group:** [morrillinsurancegroup.com](http://morrillinsurancegroup.com) · 8407 N. Crawford Ave., Kansas City, MO 64153  
- **Another option:** **BBS Insurance** compares Missouri Marketplace plans and says it helps self-employed individuals; its site lists **(816) 205-4664** and a North Kansas City office. [bbs-insurance.com/health-insurance](https://bbs-insurance.com/health-insurance/)

When you call, ask whether the broker is licensed in Missouri, which **2026 ACA Marketplace plans** they can compare, and whether they’ll check your doctors, hospitals, and prescriptions. Also ask how they’re compensated and whether they’ll help estimate your Marketplace subsidy. For ACA subsidies and enrollment, you can also compare plans directly at **HealthCare.gov**; a broker should be able to explain options without steering you away from Marketplace coverage.
